summary: The patient had an ER visit due to an overdose. They stayed in the ER for 15 hours. The patient was discharged to an unknown location.
risk_explanation: High risk (ER visit rules, not LACE): ER_OVERDOSE: ER visit for overdose/poisoning (Overdose (disorder)).

review_flags.detail: ER visit for overdose — RN review

rn_call_checklist: Confirm where the patient was discharged to.
Review the medication list to ensure the patient is taking all medications as directed.
Check if the patient has any symptoms related to the overdose, such as difficulty breathing, chest pain, or severe headache.
Ask the patient to report any changes in their condition or if they have any concerns.
